supersedes.why: R-C9-141 (Matt): the notch on the top of his helmet read as a second eye slit at play distance. Cause: the body mesh's own head (dark brown) pierced the helm piece's crown by up to ~12 mm in a crescent across the front of the dome just above the brow. eor3 tucks the body's crown under the helm shell (positions only); every clip, socket and piece is byte-identical, so the release times are unchanged. The declared eor2 pack is immutable.

source.h_model_method: rest pose, the body mesh (char1) skinned at rest by the runtime importer: crown (max up) minus sole (min up), metres (every 7th vertex; sole 0.0001, crown 1.9600)

sockets_def.main_grip: the mace grip = the right FIST in every state: RightHand + the weapon_r seat measured at rest in RightHand's normalised frame (metres). Identical to the weapon_r joint in the 7 non-spin clips (weapon_r is fixed in the hand there); in eor_spin_start/loop (final_k_eor2) the haft slide (e54) moves weapon_r 0.2 m off the fist, so weapon_r is no longer the grip. Was bone weapon_r until 2026-10-02
sockets_def.main_tip: the mace head's far point: weapon_r + 0.9251 m along +Y (measured off wl_mace.glb in the bone's frame)
sockets_def.chest: the chest: Meshy's "Spine" is the TOP spine joint (parent of neck and both shoulders; Spine02 is the LOWEST, child of Hips). Was Spine02 (belly height) until the socket fix of 2026-10-02
